verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs describe the GitHub CLI as 'an open source tool' (github-docs-31, github-docs-37), giving AI-native users a component of the product whose source they can read under an open license. However, the core GitHub.com platform, Copilot, and most other product components have no evidence of being open-licensed or source-available anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: evidence that GitHub's main platform/service source is open-licensed, license details for the CLI repo, and any indication of open-sourcing beyond the CLI tool.
